description: User says 'remember that I prefer X'. Expected: a visible memory_write_candidate is emitted, then committed to the session store with full provenance (source_event_id, created_at, confidence, salience, valid_from, user_visible_summary). Tests invariant #3 and the test_explicit_remember contract (Stage 4 activation). Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.command_surface: Explicit remember command: user names a fact to persist. Distinguishable from implicit background memory writes by the presence of an explicit_remember_command event in the trace.
fixture_conventions.memory_op_flow: user_speech_start -> explicit_remember_command -> memory_write_candidate -> memory_commit. The write_candidate is emitted before commit so the policy layer can inspect and approve the write.
fixture_conventions.provenance_fields: Every MemoryItem in the trace must carry source_event_id, created_at, confidence, salience, valid_from, valid_to, superseded_by, and user_visible_summary per invariant #3.
fixture_conventions.store_target: session_state for this sub-case (lowest-risk store; Stage 4 activation may add sub-cases for core_user_profile).
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Memory operation sequence to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
